titleTr: Başvuru süreci: önce ne oldu, sonra ne oldu?

grammar.topic: Past Perfect (by the time, before, after)
explainTr: Past Perfect, geçmişteki bir olaydan daha önce olmuş bir işi anlatır. Yapı: had + fiilin 3. hali (past participle). Tüm özneler için 'had' aynıdır: I had finished, she had finished.
'By the time', 'before' ve 'after' ile iki geçmiş olayın sırasını gösterirsin. Önce olan iş Past Perfect, sonra olan iş Past Simple olur: By the time I arrived, the office had closed.
Olumsuz: hadn't + V3. Soru: Had + özne + V3? 'Already' ve 'never' had ile V3 arasına girer: She had already left.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'gitmişti' tek kelimedir (-mişti). İngilizcede 'had gone' iki parçadır: had + V3. Hangi işin önce olduğunu bağlaçlar (before, after, by the time) ve zamanlar birlikte gösterir.
table: Yes, she had. / No, she hadn't.
Had he called? Yes, he had.
By the time I came, she had gone.

reading.title: Hafsa's application
reading.text:
Last month Hafsa decided to apply for a job as a substitute teacher in the school district. She had never filled out an application in English before, so she felt nervous. Her son Emre helped her. By the time they sat down at the computer on Saturday, Emre had already found the district website and read all the requirements.

First, Hafsa wrote her resume. She had worked with children in Isparta for six years, and she had taken a few English classes at a community college. After she had finished the resume, Emre checked it for mistakes. He said, "Mom, you had better add your computer skills." She added them.

Next, she needed two references. Her neighbor Linda had known her for a year, so she agreed immediately. Hafsa's old principal in Turkey wrote a letter, too, but it was in Turkish. By the time the letter arrived, Hafsa had found a translator who changed it into English for a small fee.

The last step was a background check. Before she could start, she had to visit the district office and give her fingerprints. Mr. Brown, the school secretary, had already told her about the deadline, so she submitted everything three days early. Two weeks later, an email arrived: the district wanted to interview her. Hafsa read it three times. Her hard work had paid off.

questions.q: When did Hafsa submit her papers?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'she submitted everything three days early.'

options: The district invited her to an interview.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'the district wanted to interview her.'

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Good morning, Hafsa. I have good news for you.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: I called the district yesterday. By the time I called, they had already read your application.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That is wonderful! Had they checked my references, too?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Yes. They had talked to Linda before they called your old school in Turkey.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I was afraid that something was missing.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Only one thing. You had not signed the background check form.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Oh no. I thought I had signed it.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Don't worry. After you sign it today, they can finish the process.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I will sign it right now. When is the interview?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Next Thursday at ten o'clock. Please arrive fifteen minutes early.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Brown.

questions.q: What is Mr. Brown's good news?
options: The district had already read the application.
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'they had already read your application.'
Mr. Brown: 'You had not signed the background check form.'
Mr. Brown: 'Next Thursday at ten o'clock.'

questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'Please arrive fifteen minutes early.'

writing.promptTr: Mr. Brown'a kısa bir e-posta yaz: başvuru sürecinde ne yaptığını, hangi işi hangisinden önce yaptığını anlat (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write a short email to Mr. Brown about your application. Say what you had done before and after each step.
frames: By the time I finished the resume, ...
writing.model: Dear Mr. Brown, thank you for your help with my application. Before I started, I had never applied for a job in English. By the time I finished the resume, Emre had checked it twice. After I had asked Linda to be my reference, I submitted everything online. I had also signed the background check form before I gave it to you. Now I am ready for the interview next Thursday. I will arrive early, and I will bring my ID. Thank you again for everything. Sincerely, Hafsa
